# Excon

Source: https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.md

# `Excon`
[🔗](https://github.com/mwmiller/excon/blob/main/lib/excon.ex#L1)

Pure Elixir identicon creator

This module dispatches to the appropriate image format based on the options provided.

# `ident`

Create an indenticon from an identifying string.

Options
  - `type`: :png or :svg  (default: :png)
  - `filename`: a string for the file name (default: nil, image data is returned)
  - `magnification`: how many times to magnify the 8x8 pattern (default: 4)
  - `base64`: should output be base64 encoded (default: false, filename overrides)

## Examples

    iex> Excon.ident("ExCon", base64: true)
    "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACAAAAAgCAMAAABEpIrGAAAADFBMVEXwwNjmqNT62dn/0tL9+OiNAAAAAklEQVR4nGKkkSsAAABBSURBVGNghAJmIGCCAhAbJs5ABwUwDkiCAQpAbJgmeiiAM4AA7jAggGmklwKYJCygkMVGkoKBjovBkiZhnAHKmwBcxQWBMC75hwAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="

    iex> Excon.ident("excon", magnification: 8, filename: "excon64")
    :ok

[🔗](https://github.com/mwmiller/excon/blob/main/lib/excon/imagemaker/duotone.ex#L1)

The :duotone interface for ExCon.

With left--to-right symmetry and a two color palette these
PNGs look a bit like GitHub identicons.

# Excon.ImageMaker.Png

Source: https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.ImageMaker.Png.md

# `Excon.ImageMaker.Png`
[🔗](https://github.com/mwmiller/excon/blob/main/lib/excon/imagemaker/png.ex#L1)

The :png interface for ExCon.

With left-to-right and top-to-bottom symmetry and a four color palette,
these PNGs look like 8-bit graphics.

# Excon.PNGUtils

Source: https://excon.hexdocs.pm/Excon.PNGUtils.md

# `Excon.PNGUtils`
[🔗](https://github.com/mwmiller/excon/blob/main/lib/excon/pngutils.ex#L1)

Utility functions for ExCon PNG image processing.

# `mirror`

# `pattern_to_png`

Converts a pattern to a PNG image data string.
The pattern is magnified by the given factor and uses the specified palette index.
